topArticle.title: Canadian government steps in as ‘out of control’ wildfires force thousands to flee
topArticle.description:
British Columbia battling 102 fires day and night across province, as breakneck speed hampers firefighters’ efforts
Canada’s federal government has announced it will provide urgent assistance to British Columbia after an onslaught of unprecedented fast-moving wildfires that killed one person and forced about 22,000 people to flee their homes in frantic evacuations.
A total of 102 wildfires were raging across the province on Sunday, of which nearly half were categorised as “out of control”, according to the BC Wildfire Service. Of those fires, 78 ignited during the past week.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: カナダ政府が介入、「制御不能」の山火事で数千人が避難

topArticle.title: Vietnam's VinSpace taps SpaceX for first satellite launches

topArticle.title: How one German city is preparing for climate extremes

topArticle.title: Ebola virus behind massive outbreak in DRC could be mutating, officials say
topArticle.description:
Cases have passed 4,000 and health watchdog plans to go door to door to find patients in major response escalation
The virus causing a massive outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be mutating, health officials fear, as confirmed cases pass 4,000.
Africa’s public health watchdog said the time for incremental action was over as they announced plans to scale up every aspect of the response and go “door to door” looking for patients.

topArticle.title: Venezuela earthquakes reveal a child protection system unprepared for disaster
topArticle.description: After Venezuela’s earthquakes, families searched for missing children within a strained protection system that struggled to respond amid collapsed buildings, scarce resources, and institutional gaps.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震が災害に備えのない児童保護システムを露呈
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの地震後、家族は崩壊した建物、乏しい資源、制度的欠陥の中で対応に苦慮するひっ迫した保護システム内で、行方不明の子供たちを捜索した。

topArticle.title: China evacuates one million from homes as massive storm arrives
topArticle.description: Typhoon Dolphin has made landfall, bringing strong winds and heavy rain across eastern China including Shanghai.
topArticle.titleJa: 中国、大型台風の接近で100万人を避難
topArticle.summary: 台風ドルフィンが中国東部に上陸し、上海を含む地域に強風と豪雨をもたらし、100万人が避難した。

topArticle.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
topArticle.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.
topArticle.titleJa: タイ首相、銃乱射事件で8人死亡を受け厳格な銃規制法導入を誓約
topArticle.summary: タイで14歳の少年が銃を乱射し8人が死亡した事件を受け、タイ首相はより厳格な銃規制法を導入すると表明した。

topArticle.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
topArticle.description: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.
topArticle.titleJa: 台風ドルフィン、沖縄を襲撃後、中国に接近
topArticle.summary: 台風ドルフィンが日本の沖縄を襲い、4万4千棟以上の建物が停電、5人が負傷。その後、中国に接近している。
